messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PAGER: GPU driver resets (Xid/ECC) on us-west1-inference-3. Error spike in model-runner service; >30% 5xx across gen-text route starting now. Incident created INC-2026-042.
ashley (oncall): Acked. I'm jumping in — looking at dashboards. Which customers showing impact?
matt (customer-success): AcmeMedia reporting media-generation timeouts; they see 502s intermittently since ~now. They've opened a support ticket.
ashley (oncall): OK noted. Quick triage: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep model-runner` shows pods on node us-west1-inference-3.* with restarts.
ashley (oncall): Logs show repeating kernel messages: `NVRM: Xid (GPU has fallen off the bus)` and `EDAC MC0: CORR_ADDR` — looks like ECC/Xid jitter.
emily (eng-runtime): Seeing tokenization requests stuck around 120ms then OOMs when batch grows. Runtime shows repeated `cudaErrorUnknown` in the container logs and then container crashloop.
raj (sre): Can we cordon + drain the node and route traffic to warm standby? Prefer draining one node at a time to avoid capacity churn.
mike (infra): Preparing cordon: `kubectl cordon us-west1-inference-3` and drain with `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. Will also taint to avoid scheduling new pods.
ashley (oncall): Do it. While drain runs, set model routing fallback to gen-text-v2 (smaller model) for customers in the affected orgs to reduce OOM pressure. Emily, can runtime toggle fallback?
emily (eng-runtime): Yes — issuing runtime config change: `POST /config/routing` body `{ "route":"/gen-text","fallback_model":"gen-text-v2","reason":"Xid spike us-west1" }` will start sending new requests to v2. Gives immediate relief.
deploy-bot: Note: autoscaler snapshot at 2429950005. No recent deploys.
mike (infra): Cordon/drain in progress. Drain logs show two pods evicted cleanly, one failing to terminate — it's stuck in Terminating due to `nvidia-persistenced` cleanup. Investigating.
ashley (oncall): If the node process isn't cleaning up, force delete the pod after giving 45s grace to flush KV cache. Use `kubectl delete pod <pod> --grace-period=45 --force --namespace=inference`.
raj (sre): Also run `nvidia-smi -q` on the host, pushing `dmesg | tail -n 50` to the thread. Might be useful for postmortem.
mike (infra): Attaching outputs: `nvidia-smi` shows one GPU with ECC errors rising, `dmesg` shows repeated `Xid 79` entries and `GPU resets`. Pasting logs to incident storage.
ashley (oncall): Customer impact update: AcmeMedia 30% error rate reduced to ~5% after fallback routing. Alerting CS to update the customer.
matt (customer-success): I'll ping Acme and tell them we've routed to fallback model and are draining affected hosts — will offer a postmortem.
emily (eng-runtime): As a short-term mitigation I pushed a runtime patch to reduce max batch size for gen-text on us-west region to avoid pushing KV growth; this is non-disruptive.
raj (sre): Medium-term mitigation: flagging these nodes for hardware inspection; schedule a maintenance window to repro and run memtest/ECC diagnostics. Also plan to pin critical customer traffic to alternate availability zone during repro.
ashley (oncall): Escalate to infra for hardware-level investigation: @mike please open a ticket with cloud provider for ECC-flare on the GPU and request a host replacement if errors continue after soft reboot.
mike (infra): Opening ticket now. Provider suggested soft reboot first — I'll try a coordinated host reboot after confirming evac of all pods.
ashley (oncall): Before we reboot, ensure we've exported model-runner KV caches/backups to S3 and that long-running requests are drained.
emily (eng-runtime): Backups triggered. Also enabling extra metrics at higher granularity for next 2 hours (per-token latency, GPU ECC counters).
ashley (oncall): Current status summary: 1) Node cordoned + drain in progress, 2) routing fallback applied (gen-text->v2), 3) customer impact reduced, 4) infra ticket opened, 5) oncall handoff planned in 2 hours to raj.
ashley (oncall): Handoff notes for raj: watch ECC counters, verify drain completes, confirm host reboot outcome, and coordinate customer PM with Matt.
raj (sre): Taking over at +2h. I'll run hardware diag and confirm next steps. If Xid persists after reboot, we'll replace host and mark pool as unhealthy.
matt (customer-success): I'll loop in Acme's technical lead and schedule a follow-up sync.
ashley (oncall): Thanks all. Closing paging loop for immediate severity; moving to incident channel for ongoing remediation. Will file a postmortem template and attach logs.
deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 moved to status: active -> investigating at 2429950098."
